flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 46, P/B 10.1. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.

threats.point: Institutional holding keeps falling - the selling has not stopped.
threats.evidence: Institutional Holding trend (quarterly): Decreasing for 8 quarters

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Long-term profit and price growth are balanced, suggesting fair valuation.

threats.point: Management noted that the inventory buildup is a temporary phenomenon driven by excess development work.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Basically, Bhavya, this is more of a temporary phenomenon because of the excess development work that's going on." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: The company experienced a decline in the Americas due to softer shunt offtake.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Americas declined 24.3% in Q2 and 11.0% in H1 on softer Shunt offtake." (concall ppt - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: Asia was weaker during the quarter and remains an area requiring focus on rebuilding momentum.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Asia was weaker during the quarter, and remains an area where we are focused on building rebuild… on rebuilding momentum." (concall transcript - 2026-08-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Dec) are still in the cycle.
